functions.name: next_pow_2
functions.signature: inline constexpr uint32_t next_pow_2(uint32_t const num)
functions.description: Returns the next power of two greater than or equal to num for 32-bit unsigned inputs. For num <= 1 it returns num; otherwise it computes using a bit-width aware shift. Intended for use in sizing buffers or aligning capacities to powers of two.
requirements: num is a 32-bit unsigned integer value (uint32_t).
Behavior relies on compiler support for __builtin_clz.
For very large inputs near UINT32_MAX, the computed shift may overflow a 32-bit result; overflow behavior is unspecified in this header (range guarantees are unknown).

functions.name: div_ceil
functions.signature:
template <typename A, typename B>
static inline constexpr auto div_ceil(A a, B b)
functions.description: Computes the mathematical ceiling of a/b using integer-like arithmetic: (a + b - 1) / b. Useful for chunking or tiling where a remainder requires an extra unit. Returns an auto-deduced type from the expression.
requirements: b must be non-zero to avoid division by zero.
Types A and B must support the operations +, -, and / with the given operands and produce a well-formed expression at compile time.
For signed integer types, the semantics follow C++ integer division/truncation toward zero; behavior for negative values depends on language rules and is not further specified here.

functions.name: round_to_previous_multiple_of
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
inline constexpr T round_to_previous_multiple_of(T a, T b)
functions.description: Rounds a down to the greatest multiple of b that is less than or equal to a. If a is already a multiple of b, returns a. Implemented using modulo and integer division.
requirements: The caller is responsible for making sure that b is non-zero (as stated in the comment).
Type T must support %, /, *, and == operations compatible with the expression used.
For signed types, behavior with negative values follows C++ operator semantics and is not further specified here.

functions.name: round_to_next_multiple_of
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
inline constexpr T round_to_next_multiple_of(T a, T b)
functions.description: Rounds a up to the smallest multiple of b that is greater than or equal to a. If a is already a multiple of b, returns a. Useful for capacity alignment and padding.
requirements: The caller is responsible for making sure that b is non-zero (as stated in the comment).
Type T must support %, /, *, +, and == operations compatible with the expression used.
For signed types, behavior with negative values follows C++ operator semantics and is not further specified here.

functions.name: aphrodite::aphrodite_is_batch_invariant
functions.description: Returns true if the environment variable APHRODITE_BATCH_INVARIANT is set to a non-zero value, false otherwise. The value is computed once and cached on first call, so subsequent calls are fast and do not reflect environment changes made after the first call.
requirements: Relies on getenv and std::atoi; the first call initializes an internal cached value which persists for the process lifetime.
Changes to the APHRODITE_BATCH_INVARIANT environment variable after the first call will not be observed.
